description: Understand what BTU per hour means on camp stoves, how efficiency, wind and fuel affect real boil times, and how many BTUs your cooking actually needs.
directAnswer: A BTU rating is the burner's maximum heat output per hour, typically 7,000 to 12,000 for backpacking stoves and 10,000 to 20,000 per burner for camp stoves. Real speed also depends on efficiency, wind protection and pot size.
